visual_goal: Show guidance as a chain of links from intent to builds, each narrowing interpretation, with conformance results flowing back to governance which revises principles and standards.
prompt: A large chain of seven interlocking metal chain links running left to right across the picture, each link labeled: 'Intent', 'Principles', 'Standards', 'Reference architectures', 'Golden paths', 'Builds', 'Conformance checks'. The links get progressively narrower and more tightly formed from left to right, and each link from 'Principles' onward carries a small checkmark badge representing its test. Below the chain, a raised podium at the center labeled 'Design authority'. One curved arrow goes from 'Conformance checks' down into 'Design authority'. Two curved arrows go from 'Design authority' back up: one into 'Principles' and one into 'Standards'. Exactly three arrows.
alt: A chain of links from Intent through Principles, Standards, Reference architectures and Golden paths to Builds and Conformance checks, with results flowing down to the design authority and arrows back up to revise principles and standards.

visual_goal: Show webhooks carrying state early and settlement reports carrying money later, both converging on one normalization layer that feeds the accounting engine, with three-way matching proving clearing accounts empty out against the bank.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. At the far left, two inputs stacked: on top a lightning bolt labeled 'Webhooks' with a small tag 'state, early'; below it a document stack labeled 'Settlement reports' with a small tag 'money, later'. One arrow from each into a single funnel in the middle labeled 'Normalization'. From the funnel, one arrow up-right into a gear machine labeled 'Accounting engine', and one arrow down-right into a three-pan balance scale labeled 'Three-way matching'. From 'Accounting engine', one arrow down into a set of buckets labeled 'Clearing accounts', drawn emptying out. From 'Clearing accounts' one arrow into 'Three-way matching'. A bank building at the lower right labeled 'Bank' with one arrow into 'Three-way matching'. From 'Three-way matching', one arrow down into a small tray labeled 'Exceptions'. Exactly eight arrows.
alt: Webhooks with early state and settlement reports with later money converge on one normalization funnel, which feeds the accounting engine and three-way matching; clearing accounts and the bank also feed matching, with exceptions flowing to a tray.

visual_goal: Show the summary carrying a drill-back key and control totals to the GL, which accepts or rejects whole batches and returns a document number, and a daily tie-out comparing both sides and sending differences to reconciliation.
prompt: A two-row illustration. Top row, left to right: an open book labeled 'Subledger' with many small lines; one arrow into a funnel labeled 'Summarizer'; one arrow carrying a single sealed envelope with a luggage-style key tag labeled 'summary_id' into a large open book labeled 'General ledger', which shows a round stamp with a green check and a red cross labeled 'whole batch'. One thin dashed arrow returns from 'General ledger' to 'Summarizer' carrying a small receipt labeled 'GL document number'. Bottom row: in the middle, directly below the funnel, a balance scale labeled 'Daily tie-out'; its left pan has a dotted line up to 'Subledger' and its right pan has a dotted line up to 'General ledger', showing it weighs both books. At the bottom right, a desk with an unlabeled person labeled 'Reconciliation', with one arrow from 'Daily tie-out' into it. The 'Reconciliation' desk has no other connections.
alt: The subledger's lines are summarized into a batch carrying a summary_id key and control totals, the general ledger accepts or rejects the whole batch and returns its document number, and a daily tie-out compares both sides and sends differences to reconciliation.

visual_goal: Show close orchestration: ledgers emit cut-off signals that release calendar tasks, matching leads to certification, consolidation locks an entity only after certification, and every gate writes evidence that monitors query.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration on two rows. Top row, left to right: a signal tower with a flag labeled 'Cut-off signals'; one arrow into a large wall calendar labeled 'Close calendar'; one arrow into a three-pan balance scale labeled 'Matching'; one arrow into a document with a seal labeled 'Certification'; one arrow into a padlocked gate labeled 'Entity lock'; one arrow into a stack of combined books labeled 'Consolidation'. Bottom row: a long filing cabinet spanning most of the width labeled 'Evidence store'. Four short dashed arrows drop down into it, from 'Cut-off signals', 'Matching', 'Certification' and 'Entity lock'. At the bottom right, a monitor screen with a heartbeat line labeled 'Control monitors', with one arrow from 'Evidence store' into it, and one long curved arrow from 'Control monitors' back up to 'Close calendar'. Exactly eleven arrows.
alt: Cut-off signals release tasks in the close calendar, which flow to matching, certification, an entity lock gate and consolidation; four gates write to a shared evidence store that control monitors query, feeding exceptions back to the calendar.
